I went in with my dog ​​to see if he had protective boots. As soon as I walked in, there was no greeting. I asked if the person could help me. Her response was, "No boots, but maybe they have them on Avenue du Prado." I asked if she could call the store to confirm, she just looked at me, puffed out her cheeks, and left. I will never set foot in that store again. Extremely rude staff.

I am very disappointed with the service at this store. The staff were unpleasant and unprofessional. Just 10 minutes before closing time, an employee abruptly informed me that the store was closing, even though his colleague had already told me this 20 seconds earlier. This way of speaking to customers is regrettable and makes me not want to return. Avoid at all costs.
Is the phone out of order, or do they just not want to answer? It's been months.
The store is clean and well-organized. The checkout area needs improvement. It's too small and cramped.
Everything was great, thank you to the team. I recommend it for its convenient location, easy access, and proximity to public transport. Animals are welcome.

There's nothing negative to say, only positive things. The staff are very welcoming and pleasant, and always offer excellent advice. Keep up the good work, there's nothing to change! Whether it's food, carriers, or toys, there's something for everyone.
We tried their "click and collect" service and had no complaints!
After ID verification at pickup, the products were indeed set aside (this was after several days of waiting for pickup – I hadn't been able to go earlier).
A place worth knowing!

There's a salesperson in this store who's incredibly knowledgeable about the composition of kibble and other pet food. He took the time to explain his expertise to me, and the kibble he recommended is absolutely perfect! My cat no longer vomits or has respiratory problems. A huge thank you to him!!!

They have many different brands to suit all tastes and preferences, and the staff are all incredibly attentive and friendly, always with a smile. good store they have everything for my cat :)
Good service!

Great saleswoman! Thank you for your welcome! But absolutely zero for the store manager! What a disgrace to leave his customers and employees in 35-degree heat in the store! No air conditioning today (yes, a fan blowing hot air that's an eyesore in the middle of the store with an enormous noise!) Tuesday, July 1st! 35 degrees in the store, it's a disgrace!
4 stars for the store's dog. Minus one star for the reception from the two saleswomen; they were neither friendly nor customer-oriented.
Very kind and gave excellent advice!

The store is well-stocked and offers many options for pets. The loyalty program works wonderfully, as do online ordering and click & collect. The only downside: one employee isn't very friendly. I recommend it for everything else. They always offer good discounts and their products are of very good quality.

5 stars for the sales staff (including the amazing Kenza who gives fantastic advice!)
0 stars for the brand… When will you open a well-stocked store in the city center? There are so few products, which is a real shame.

And the worst part: no air conditioning in your store in the heart of Marseille? It's unbearable for customers and their pets, and your sales staff are practically suffering from heatstroke; they're truly pitiful to see. Tomorrow it's supposed to be 34 degrees Celsius (93 degrees Fahrenheit), I don't know how they'll cope!

I find it outrageous to leave employees in such working conditions, and it's really bad for your image!

To the saleswoman Kenza and her dog Uipet, you both deserve a review!

I wanted to sincerely thank you for your invaluable help today. Your warm welcome and expert advice truly made all the difference compared to other pet stores. I greatly appreciated your professionalism and your patience in answering all my questions. Thanks to you, I found exactly what I was looking for and I am very happy with my purchase.

Your expertise is truly impressive, and it's clear that you love what you do. It's always a pleasure to meet passionate people like you.

Thank you again for your excellent service and kindness. I will definitely be back!
See you soon!

A huge thank you to the Animalis Marseille Montgrand team, especially the two lovely advisors who welcomed us with such kindness and professionalism. Their attentiveness, gentleness, and invaluable advice truly made a difference.

On behalf of the Meliinamonchat association, dedicated to the care and feeding of abandoned cats, we wanted to acknowledge their availability and support for our cause. This kind of warm welcome is heartwarming and makes us want to come back.

Thank you for your compassion and dedication ❤️

— The Meliinamonchat Association
I don't know this store, but I'll go and check it out because every time I go to Maxi Zoo in La Valentine I don't always find my products.

Practically nothing for birds. So we order online.
Too bad for local businesses 😞
---- Edit May 2025 > in response to the owner!!!

Regarding the online ordering solution, I did consider it.

Except that the orders are being canceled by Animalis.

Supposedly due to lack of stock, even though the product is available online.
This has happened to me several times. >:-(
It's ridiculous!!! I'm switching stores.
Too many unreliable options.

This company is completely unreliable!

We order online because the store doesn't have the products we need in stock. In-store pickup is part of the deal.

And then your orders are canceled under the pretext of unavailability, even though the items are listed as available on the online store.

It's easy to conclude that they cancel because they don't care about delivering to their physical store.

This company has done this to me twice in less than a week.

The worst part is that I ordered a product to treat my rabbit. I'll have to order elsewhere and wait another four days.

In total: at least seven days wasted, and these animals are very fragile.

I'm not thanking this company and I'm furious about their practices.

This has nothing to do with the retailer, who is doing what they can with what they're allowed to do, or not.

The store has practically nothing but everyday items on the shelves. Essentially, cat and dog food, and a few accessories.

But almost nothing for the care of other animals.

So we're forced to order online.

And Animalis cancels orders whenever it feels like it.

I'm furious with this company that treats its customers—and by extension, their pets—with utter carelessness and inconsistency >:-(
Fantastic store! I don't shop anywhere else anymore. The quality, the selection at all price points, the welcoming staff – it has everything!

Thank you to Kenza, the sales assistant. I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for the warm welcome and attentive service you provided during my last visit to Animalis. Your product knowledge and passion for animals truly shine through, making the in-store experience even more enjoyable.

Thank you for your patience and valuable advice; it really made a difference. 😊

I wish you a wonderful day and continued success in your work.
Nothing to say

A new, happy pet has joined my family.

A huge thank you to Serge and Evan who guided and advised me with a smile and good humor, from the initial phone call to picking up the pet in store. 👍 …
Top-notch team, attentive and offering good advice, taking the time to provide thorough information. Thanks again to the team! Minilop
Good range of goods (we have a cat). Did exactly what we needed and even had our applaws cat food which you rarely see.

I'm a loyal customer of this store, but this experience has left me feeling very uneasy.

During my last order, I went to the checkout to pick up my package—everything seemed normal. Until one of the sales assistants pointed to a completely open box, with items half-unpacked. I honestly thought it was a joke.

They explained that they had opened the package to "check" its contents… fine. But no effort was made to reseal it afterward. Absolutely nothing. The box was presented to me just like that, wide open, as if it were perfectly normal.

When I asked them to sort it out, I was met with blasé looks and an attitude that clearly made me feel like I was bothering them. And to top it all off, before even addressing my request, one of the sales assistants sarcasticly told me to "good luck" with a smile.

This isn't the first time I've been to this store, but it will be the last. Here's a photo of the box I received, so everyone can judge for themselves the level of professionalism in question.

Customer respect? Completely absent.
Friendly welcome. Well-stocked store.

Last week I went to buy a 4kg bag of puppy food. I asked at the checkout, where there were two people serving and no other customers. The young man told me, "She can't lift anything heavy!" I'm 74 years old, and he didn't even bother to help me. I had to go and get the bag from up high all by myself! They've lost a customer...
It's going very well.

All the staff are incredibly welcoming and friendly! I just adopted my first dog and they gave me excellent advice! I went there to get all the essentials before he arrived. The selection is admittedly smaller compared to other Animalis stores, but that's the case for all types of stores, whether they're in the city or the shopping center (like Decathlon, Gifi, etc.), so it's to be expected. No complaints whatsoever.
Caroline is incredibly kind and an exceptional advisor. She takes pride in providing all the necessary guidance; truly amazing, I will definitely be back because of her.
Very good experience, there is a lot of choice and I was advised according to my requests.
